methods.label: Compare directly applicable criteria
methods.explanation: Here, interpret “requires using HL” as asking which criterion applies directly to the given data. A allows SAS using the equal right angles, B allows AAS, and D allows ASA or AAS. C gives equal corresponding hypotenuses and one pair of equal corresponding legs, which are precisely the HL conditions. Therefore, the answer is C under this interpretation. This does not claim that HL is the only possible proof after deriving additional facts.
methods.levelReason: The method compares the standard Grade 8 congruence criteria using the given right angles.
